arguments.content:
"""Tiny JSON-backed notes store.

Notes live in a JSON file containing an array of strings.  A missing file is
treated as an empty list.  Only the Python standard library is used.

Public API
----------
add(note, path='notes.json')     -> int      (1-based position of the new note)
list(path='notes.json')          -> list[str]
delete(index, path='notes.json') -> str      (the removed note)
"""

import json
import os
import tempfile

__all__ = ["add", "list", "delete"]

DEFAULT_PATH = "notes.json"


def _read(path):
    """Return the notes stored in *path* as a list of strings.

    A missing (or empty) file yields an empty list.
    """
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            raw = handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []

    if not raw.strip():
        return []

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError("%r does not contain valid JSON: %s" % (path, exc)) from exc

    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ValueError("%r must contain a JSON array of strings" % (path,))
    if not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in data):
        raise ValueError("%r must contain a JSON array of strings" % (path,))
    return data


def _write(path, notes):
    """Persist *notes* to *path* atomically.

    The data is written to a temporary file in the destination directory and
    then moved into place, so a failure never leaves a half-written file
    behind.
    """
    directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump(notes, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            handle.write("\n")
        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise


def add(note, path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Append *note* to the store and return its 1-based position."""
    if not isinstance(note, str):
        raise TypeError("note must be a string")
    notes = _read(path)
    notes.append(note)
    _write(path, notes)
    return len(notes)


def list(path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Return the stored notes in insertion order."""
    return _read(path)


def delete(index, path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Delete the 1-based note *index* and return the removed note.

    Raises IndexError when *index* is outside the stored notes; the JSON file
    is left untouched in that case.
    """
    if isinstance(index, bool) or not isinstance(index, int):
        raise TypeError("index must be an integer")
    notes = _read(path)
    position = index - 1
    if not 0 <= position < len(notes):
        raise IndexError(
            "note number %d out of range (1..%d)" % (index, len(notes))
        )
    removed = notes.pop(position)
    _write(path, notes)
    return removed

import ast
import json
import os
import sys

import pytest

import notes


@pytest.fixture
def path(tmp_path):
    return str(tmp_path / "notes.json")


def read_raw(p):
    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def test_imports_only_stdlib():
    with open(notes.__file__, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        tree = ast.parse(handle.read())

    modules = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            modules.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0:
            if node.module:
                modules.add(node.module.split(".")[0])

    assert modules, "expected at least one import to verify"
    assert modules <= set(sys.stdlib_module_names), modules - set(
        sys.stdlib_module_names
    )


def test_list_missing_file_returns_empty_list(path):
    assert not os.path.exists(path)
    assert notes.list(path) == []


def test_default_path_is_notes_json(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert notes.add("hello") == 1
    assert (tmp_path / "notes.json").exists()
    assert notes.list() == ["hello"]
    assert json.loads((tmp_path / "notes.json").read_text()) == ["hello"]


def test_add_appends_and_persists(path):
    assert notes.add("first", path) == 1
    assert notes.add("second", path) == 2
    assert read_raw(path) == ["first", "second"]
    assert notes.list(path) == ["first", "second"]


def test_list_returns_fresh_copy_in_insertion_order(path):
    for text in ("a", "b", "c"):
        notes.add(text, path)
    result = notes.list(path)
    assert result == ["a", "b", "c"]
    result.append("mutated")
    assert notes.list(path) == ["a", "b", "c"]


def test_unicode_and_newlines_round_trip(path):
    sample = "caf\u00e9 \u2603 line1\nline2"
    notes.add(sample, path)
    assert notes.list(path) == [sample]


def test_delete_uses_one_based_numbering_and_persists(path):
    for text in ("one", "two", "three"):
        notes.add(text, path)
    assert notes.delete(2, path) == "two"
    assert notes.list(path) == ["one", "three"]
    assert read_raw(path) == ["one", "three"]


def test_delete_first_and_last(path):
    for text in ("one", "two", "three"):
        notes.add(text, path)
    assert notes.delete(1, path) == "one"
    assert notes.delete(2, path) == "three"
    assert notes.list(path) == ["two"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", [0, -1, 4, 100])
def test_delete_out_of_range_raises_and_preserves_file(path, index):
    for text in ("one", "two", "three"):
        notes.add(text, path)
    before = open(path, "rb").read()

    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        notes.delete(index, path)

    assert open(path, "rb").read() == before
    assert notes.list(path) == ["one", "two", "three"]


def test_delete_out_of_range_on_missing_file(path):
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        notes.delete(1, path)
    assert not os.path.exists(path)


def test_delete_non_integer_index_raises_type_error(path):
    notes.add("one", path)
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        notes.delete("1", path)
    assert notes.list(path) == ["one"]


def test_add_rejects_non_string(path):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        notes.add(42, path)
    assert not os.path.exists(path)


def test_empty_file_treated_as_empty_list(path):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("")
    assert notes.list(path) == []
    assert notes.add("x", path) == 1
    assert read_raw(path) == ["x"]


def test_invalid_json_raises_value_error(path):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("{not json")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        notes.list(path)


def test_non_array_json_raises_value_error(path):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump({"a": "b"}, handle)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        notes.list(path)


def test_non_string_entries_raise_value_error(path):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(["ok", 5], handle)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        notes.list(path)


def test_creates_missing_parent_directory(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "nested" / "dir" / "notes.json"
    notes.add("deep", str(target))
    assert json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == ["deep"]


def test_no_stray_temp_files_left_behind(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "notes.json"
    notes.add("one", str(target))
    notes.delete(1, str(target))
    entries = sorted(p.name for p in tmp_path.iterdir())
    assert entries == ["notes.json"]

arguments.content:
"""Tiny JSON-backed notes store.

Notes live in a JSON file containing an array of strings.  A missing file is
treated as an empty list.  Only the Python standard library is used.

Public API
----------
add(note, path='notes.json')     -> int             (1-based position of new note)
list(path='notes.json')          -> list of str     (notes in insertion order)
delete(index, path='notes.json') -> str             (the removed note)

Note: the public ``list`` function shadows the builtin inside this module, so
the builtin is referenced explicitly as ``builtins.list`` where needed.
"""

import builtins
import json
import os
import tempfile

__all__ = ["add", "list", "delete"]

DEFAULT_PATH = "notes.json"


def _read(path):
    """Return the notes stored in *path* as a list of strings.

    A missing (or empty) file yields an empty list.
    """
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            raw = handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []

    if not raw.strip():
        return []

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise ValueError("%r does not contain valid JSON: %s" % (path, exc)) from exc

    if not isinstance(data, builtins.list):
        raise ValueError("%r must contain a JSON array of strings" % (path,))
    if not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in data):
        raise ValueError("%r must contain a JSON array of strings" % (path,))
    return data


def _write(path, notes):
    """Persist *notes* to *path* atomically.

    The data is written to a temporary file in the destination directory and
    then moved into place, so a failure never leaves a half-written file
    behind.
    """
    directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump(notes, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            handle.write("\n")
        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise


def add(note, path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Append *note* to the store and return its 1-based position."""
    if not isinstance(note, str):
        raise TypeError("note must be a string")
    notes = _read(path)
    notes.append(note)
    _write(path, notes)
    return len(notes)


def list(path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Return the stored notes in insertion order."""
    return _read(path)


def delete(index, path=DEFAULT_PATH):
    """Delete the 1-based note *index* and return the removed note.

    Raises IndexError when *index* is outside the stored notes; the JSON file
    is left untouched in that case.
    """
    if isinstance(index, bool) or not isinstance(index, int):
        raise TypeError("index must be an integer")
    notes = _read(path)
    position = index - 1
    if not 0 <= position < len(notes):
        raise IndexError("note number %d out of range (1..%d)" % (index, len(notes)))
    removed = notes.pop(position)
    _write(path, notes)
    return removed
